title: The Phantom in the Archive
subtitle: Round 3 — AI Chaos Room
summary: A renowned historian was found dead in the university archives. Ancient documents are missing. The security system shows a ghost who shouldn't exist. Was it revenge, greed... or something buried for centuries?

suspects.name: Rohit Sen
suspects.bio: Manages the archive system. Has technical skills and full access privileges.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was running routine system backups in the server room.
suspects.motive: Stole the codex to sell to private artifact collectors for massive financial gain.

suspects.name: Dr. Meera Iyer
suspects.bio: Wanted the discovery for her own upcoming book. Had a heated argument with Prof. Rao.
suspects.alibi: Reading in the main study hall on Floor 1.
suspects.motive: Furious that Prof. Rao refused to list her as co-author.

suspects.name: Vikram Nair
suspects.bio: Working on the same project. Needed groundbreaking results for his doctoral defense.

suspects.name: Anita Deshpande
suspects.bio: Knows the archive better than anyone. Resented Prof. Rao's strict authority.
suspects.alibi: Closing up the front reception desk.
suspects.motive: Resentment over budget allocation and administrative disputes.

suspects.name: Unknown Intruder
suspects.bio: No physical identity. Used a spoofed ghost account that shouldn't exist.
suspects.motive: Digital proxy created to mask the true killer.

evidence.title: Last Email Draft (Unsent)
evidence.content:
To: archive.team@univ.edu
Subject: Urgent - Almost There

If anyone reads this, something has gone terribly wrong. The Nahapur Codex reveals a truth that could rewrite history. I've hidden the final page. They've been watching me. If I don't show up tomorrow, trust no one.
- A.R.

evidence.title: Hidden Clue & Shelf B7 Scribble
evidence.content:
On the back of a book in shelf B7 was a tiny symbol matching the carving on Prof. Rao's desk.
Scribble found: 'Numbers don't lie, but people do. The year is the key. Look where it all began.'

evidence.title: Extra Clue (Decipher Puzzle)
evidence.content:
Decode using A=1, B=2 ... Z=26:
14-1-8-1-16-21-18  3-15-4-5-24 -> N-A-H-A-P-U-R  C-O-D-E-X
Hint: The place holds the answers.

Bypassed security by disabling circuit breakers
